As an industry leader, we are dedicated to the science and research of innovative biologic medicine

A peer-reviewed study evaluating the XCELL PRP System has been published in Bioengineering,
demonstrating consistent platelet recovery, customizable PRP formulations, and significant red blood

## Regenerative Medicine Solutions

FDA-registered Class II PRP system engineered for precision and performance


APEX Biologix offers a comprehensive portfolio of FDA-registered Class II autologous biologic
systems, including Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP), Protein Concentrate (A2M), and Bone Marrow
Concentrate (BMC). Engineered for precision, efficiency, and reproducibility, XCELL platforms are
designed to optimize biologic yield, streamline processing, and reduce variability while supporting
advanced regenerative medicine applications across orthopedics, sports medicine, interventional
pain, integrative care, and aesthetics.

APEX Biologix is at the forefront of advancing interventional orthobiologics, where innovation,

the science and education of regenerative medicine."

** John Knab, MD **

osteoarthritis."

** Steven Poon, M.D., C.A.Q.S.M **

therapeutic PRP concentrations that are aligned with emerging orthopedic standards. The company's
focus on research and scientific validation, combined with a system that is both flexible, efficient
and easy to use, positions APEX to become a leader in evidence-based regenerative care."

** Walter Sussman, DO **
Physician/Owner Boston Sports & Biologics

## Regenerative Medicine Solutions

FDA-registered Class II PRP system engineered for precision and performance

systems, including Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP), Protein Concentrate (A2M), and Bone Marrow

designed to optimize biologic yield, streamline processing, and reduce variability while supporting
advanced regenerative medicine applications across orthopedics, sports medicine, interventional
pain, integrative care, and aesthetics.

## Welcome to Esco Lifesciences!
## A world-leading manufacturer and service provider of life science tools

Esco Lifesciences is a world-leading life science company with a diversified portfolio and sales in
over 100 countries. As a manufacturer of laboratory and biopharma equipment, and IVF medical
devices, Esco offers tailored solutions that fit the needs of laboratories in various industries.

Esco Lifesciences contributes to meet the challenges of the 21st century with a diverse range of
business units. The company continuously innovates its products to help the clinical and industrial
laboratories achieve successful conclusions in research and development, quality control, and
analysis. We continue to provide reliable world-class equipment to help pharmaceutical companies
make their products safer and more cost-effective. And with the increasing demand of the IVF
industry, we have developed efficient ART equipment to enable equitable access to infertility care.

over 100 countries. As a manufacturer of laboratory and biopharma equipment, and IVF medical
devices, Esco offers tailored solutions that fit the needs of laboratories in various industries.

Esco Lifesciences contributes to meet the challenges of the 21st century with a diverse range of
business units. The company continuously innovates its products to help the clinical and industrial
laboratories achieve successful conclusions in research and development, quality control, and
analysis. We continue to provide reliable world-class equipment to help pharmaceutical companies
make their products safer and more cost-effective. And with the increasing demand of the IVF
industry, we have developed efficient ART equipment to enable equitable access to infertility care.

## **High‑Performance Gas Filtration with Lower CAPEX**

 

Pall’s High Flow Gas solution delivers reliable particulate removal for large‑volume gas streams
while helping operators lower upfront CAPEX. Smaller vessels and fewer elements reduce footprint and
maintenance demands while protecting downstream equipment and supporting long‑term performance.

 

[
Learn More High‑Performance Gas Filtration
][53]

## **Revolutionizing Filtration for the Food & Beverage Industry**

 

Membralox® GP-IC ceramic membrane systems deliver cleaner, more efficient processing with less waste
and downtime. Designed for demanding applications, they help manufacturers transform premium
ingredients and alternative protein production while reducing footprint and cost.

 

[
Learn More Membralox GP-IC
][54]

## **Supralon^{®} Replacement Oil Filter Elements**

 

With high efficiency and consistent performance, our Supralon Filter Elements enable customers to
rapidly achieve and maintain required cleanliness levels that protect lube and hydraulic systems
against component failure and unscheduled downtime that can cost tens of thousands of dollars per
hour.

 

[
Learn More Visit Supralon
][55]

### Passionate About Solving Your Toughest Challenges



Since 1946, Pall has pushed the limits of science and technology to tackle the most complex
filtration, separation, and purification challenges. From safeguarding health and critical assets to
improving quality and reducing waste, we collaborate with customers to turn the unsolvable into
solutions that drive progress.

[
[Learn about Pall’s quality commitments, policies, and standards supporting consistent, high
performance filtration and purification solutions.]

Building a truly sustainable future requires an overhaul of complex processes, across the globe.

Pall technologies can handle beers at different filterability levels. Intelligent processes,

Semiconductor manufacturers choose Pall filtration and purification products for their

## **High‑Performance Gas Filtration with Lower CAPEX**

 

Pall’s High Flow Gas solution delivers reliable particulate removal for large‑volume gas streams
while helping operators lower upfront CAPEX. Smaller vessels and fewer elements reduce footprint and
maintenance demands while protecting downstream equipment and supporting long‑term performance.

 

[
Learn More High‑Performance Gas Filtration
][53]

## **Revolutionizing Filtration for the Food & Beverage Industry**

 

Membralox® GP-IC ceramic membrane systems deliver cleaner, more efficient processing with less waste
and downtime. Designed for demanding applications, they help manufacturers transform premium
ingredients and alternative protein production while reducing footprint and cost.

 

[
Learn More Membralox GP-IC
][54]

## **Supralon^{®} Replacement Oil Filter Elements**

 

With high efficiency and consistent performance, our Supralon Filter Elements enable customers to
rapidly achieve and maintain required cleanliness levels that protect lube and hydraulic systems
against component failure and unscheduled downtime that can cost tens of thousands of dollars per
hour.

 

[
Learn More Visit Supralon
][55]

Since 1946, Pall has pushed the limits of science and technology to tackle the most complex
filtration, separation, and purification challenges. From safeguarding health and critical assets to
improving quality and reducing waste, we collaborate with customers to turn the unsolvable into
solutions that drive progress.

Advalab Scientific manufactures rugged lab equipment for US research universities, clinical
diagnostics labs, and industrial QC facilities. We design and build systems for high-stakes
workflows where precision and compliance are non-negotiable. From sample prep to long-term storage,
our gear plugs right into your SOPs for seamless operations and rock-solid data integrity.

Our portfolio delivers CO2 incubators, ultra-low temp freezers, lab refrigerators, and water baths
for thermal management. For analytical tasks and safety, count on spectrophotometers, ultrasonic
cleaners, high-flow fume hoods, stability test chambers, and lab-grade ice machines.
Industrial-grade materials ensure pinpoint control for processing and environmental testing.

UL-listed, FDA 21 CFR Part 11 ready, certified ISO 9001:2015, 13485:2016, 17025:2017, CE-marked, and
GMP-aligned. Stay audit-proof and compliant. Spec your setup today.

[

# Lab Equipment

][17]

We offer a diverse selection of lab equipment designed to meet research and industrial applications.
Our extensive range includes Lab Refrigerator, Freezer, Water Bath, Spectrophotometer, Ice Maker,
Test Chamber, Ultrasonic Cleaner, Biological Safety Cabinet, Fume Hood and more. We design our
instruments to comply with stringent quality standards, ensuring reliability and consistency in
laboratory environments.

[

## Test Chambers

][69]

Our Test Chamber is designed for high performance and features precise temperature and humidity
control. These are equipped with programmable controllers that enable users to automate multiple
testing cycles, enhancing operational efficiency and accuracy. They maintain uniform airflow and
distribution systems for optimal conditions and reliable results for product durability. These
feature multiple testing modes available, including thermal cycling, vibration, and shock testing
accommodating a wide range of product assessments. Complies with ISO, ASTM, and IEC for dependable
performance in environmental testing for various applications.

# What People Say?

"I use this hood five times a week. We have not had any problems what so ever. We also have four
other hoods in our operation, all different brands, and this is by far one of our best."

Savana FisherApplication Area: Plant Cell Tissue Culture
"We are greatly satisfied with this product! Not only did it ship in great time, but the quality is
fantastic. After shipping I simply removed it from the box and it was practically ready to use. The
UV light works great and I love the easy to use built in pipette holder in the back! I haven't had
any cross over contamination while working with PCR assays since I purchased this product."

Kelsey RogersKentucky Cannabis Company
"This piece of equipment is a must have for all labs that use chemical processing for latent prints.
Processed a note from a notebook from a homicide scene and had identifiable latent impressions on
the paper. This unit has taken our division to a whole new level. The machine is very easy to
operate and produces high quality results. The machine is sized right and is great value for money."

Mark MaskuleApplication Area: Chemical Processing
"I have purchased 5 PTEFH-72 Exhaust fume hoods from Air Science and have been 100% satisfied. One
of my purchases had a damaged shelf and I was rushed a replacement. I have dealt with Devon Kramer
on numerous occasions, and my customer service was better than I have had in a very long time. If
you are looking for top notch product and excellent service, these guys cannot be beat. I order a
lot of equipment for my shop and when I was sent an invitation to review this company I jumped at
it. Big thanks for making buying a better experience."

Chris WoodApplication Area: Exhaust Hood for Battery Filling

### Biosafety and Contamination Control

Diverse applications in the life science, clinical, pharmaceutical, and industrial laboratory fields
must protect personnel, product, and the environment from exposure to biohazards and
cross-contamination. Since Baker developed the first clean air workstation in 1951, biosafety
cabinets have played a critical role in ensuring the safety of lab personnel and the integrity of

### Biosafety and Contamination Control

Diverse applications in the life science, clinical, pharmaceutical, and industrial laboratory fields
must protect personnel, product, and the environment from exposure to biohazards and
cross-contamination. Since Baker developed the first clean air workstation in 1951, biosafety
cabinets have played a critical role in ensuring the safety of lab personnel and the integrity of
their work.
[Find out more About Biosafety and Contamination Control][90]

### Aseptic Biopharmaceutical Processing

Aseptic bioprocessing is a method of manufacturing that produces foods and pharmaceuticals that are
free of bacteria without subjecting the final product to terminal sterilization.  Baker has
innovative solutions for a variety of bioprocessing workflows.
[Find out more About Aseptic Biopharmaceutical Processing][91]

### Cell Culture and Life Science Research

Understanding the benefits on creating ideal growth environments are creating exciting innovations
in how cell culture work is performed. Culture workflows are attempting to create stable and
continuous conditions. This creates less stress on cells and optimizes their growth potential.
[Find out more About Cell Culture and Life Science Research][92]

### Pharmaceutical Compounding

USP 797 and USP 800 provide the guidelines for compounding sterile preparations and the standards
for safe handling of hazardous drugs to minimize risk to healthcare personnel, patients, and the
environment. Baker is proud to provide support to pharmaceutical professionals to help them stay
current on the latest issues about aseptic preparation of parenteral drug products.
[Find out more About Pharmaceutical Compounding][93]

### Microbiology and Microbiome

Microbiological research plays a critical role in the development and safe production of drugs,
foods, beverages, and vaccines. This work helps stop the spread of viruses and diseases through
increased knowledge of how the microbes behave, their genetics, and how they are transmitted.
[Find out more About Microbiology and Microbiome][94]

## Baker has been at the forefront of engineering, testing and production of reliable laboratory
## contamination control equipment.

We take no chances with safety and make no compromises when it comes to protecting the success of
your research. Baker specializes in built-to-order products designed expressly for your unique
application need.

Our rigorous testing protocols go above and beyond the standards and our quality control measures
exceed industry expectations. Baker’s commitment to sustainable business practices and the
development of a new generation of energy efficient products ensures that you — and your budget —
will be pleased.

## *About Us*

Founded in 1999, BIOBASE is a professional manufacturer whose business covers laboratory equipment,
medical device, engineering project and cosmetics. With more than 3,000 employees, 25+ factories,
BIOBASE has established overseas branches in USA, UAE, Singapore, Kazakhstan, India and other
countries. BIOBASE has long-term business partners in 190+ countries. BIOBASE can provide one-stop
solutions for laboratory and medical fields. Main products include biological safety cabinet,
laminar flow cabinet, fume hood, refrigerator & freezer, autoclave, oven, incubator, centrifuge,
wheel chair, hospital bed, IVD instrument, clean room project, etc. BIOBASE has certificates
including ISO9001, ISO13485, ISO14001, ISO45001, FDA, NSF49, EN12469, MET, CE, ETL, etc. BIOBASE
would like to establish win-win business cooperation with distributors all over the world.

## *About Us*

## *About Us*

Founded in 1999, BIOBASE is a professional manufacturer whose business covers laboratory equipment,
medical device, engineering project and cosmetics. With more than 3,000 employees, 25+ factories,
BIOBASE has established overseas branches in USA, UAE, Singapore, Kazakhstan, India and other
countries. BIOBASE has long-term business partners in 190+ countries. BIOBASE can provide one-stop
solutions for laboratory and medical fields. Main products include biological safety cabinet,
laminar flow cabinet, fume hood, refrigerator & freezer, autoclave, oven, incubator, centrifuge,
wheel chair, hospital bed, IVD instrument, clean room project, etc. BIOBASE has certificates
including ISO9001, ISO13485, ISO14001, ISO45001, FDA, NSF49, EN12469, MET, CE, ETL, etc. BIOBASE
would like to establish win-win business cooperation with distributors all over the world.

### What is CheckerTR PRO?

CheckerTR PRO is an all-in-one GSM repair toolkit for professional technicians. It covers IMEI
repair, FRP bypass, data recovery, and flashing for most Android brands.

### Which brands are supported?

We support Samsung, Xiaomi, MediaTek, Qualcomm, Huawei, Oppo, Realme, Infinix, Tecno, and many other
brands with dedicated service modules.

Our hatch cover testing solutions quickly and accurately verify watertight integrity, helping
protect vessels, cargo, and operational safety.

# Our Engineering Services

## Innovative Services to Drive Precision and Progress

Coupled to our manufacturing facilities and research laboratories is our Services Division, which
provides bespoke research, product design and engineering solutions across all Technology Readiness
Levels (TRLs), spanning electronics, sensor design and complete end-to-end product development;
electromagnetic, Artificial Intelligence, Quantum, and acoustic research; systems and information
engineering; analytical monitoring; and AI testing and development.

[ [Home | Coltraco] ][110]

### [Scientific Services To Accelerate Innovation][111]

With over 600 Fellows across the UK’s top universities, we provide scientific insight,
interdisciplinary collaboration, and end-to-end research services across physics, engineering, AI,
quantum technologies, fluid dynamics, sensor development, and more.

[ Learn More ][112]
[ [Home | Coltraco] ][113]

Coltraco offers a comprehensive Product Design & Engineering Service, helping businesses develop
cutting-edge solutions that help customers address challenges with safety, efficiency and
compliance.

[ Learn More ][115]
[ [Home | Coltraco] ][116]

### [AI Test & Evaluation][117]

AI is strategically vital to the UK’s economy and national security. Our AI Test & Evaluation
services aim to help to establish a robust, transparent, and adaptive framework to support their
adoption, for strategic advantage.

[ Learn More ][118]

## Trusted Around The World.

### We are a Manufacturing, Scientific, Research and Technological Development & Solutions
### Organisation comprising:

Coltraco Ultrasonics, with our laboratory, The Durham Institute of Research, Development & Invention
(DIRDI), The Centre for Underwater Acoustic Analysis (CUAA).

Seeing the sounds that others cannot hear, with specialist technologies in industrial sensors &
instrumentation, non-invasive ultrasonic monitoring systems, automated inspection & data capture
devices, structural integrity assessment tools, and complex naval & marine fire suppression system
monitoring.

**We aim to become the UK’s Sovereign sensor developer and manufacturer**
* Across Ultrasonic, Acoustic, Electromagnetic and Mechanical, Quantum and AI R&D
* Information engineering, Analytical monitoring
* And now, Artificial Intelligence Testing and Evaluation Services

**Built on high-exporting UK Manufacturing. Working in partnership with world-leading academics in
UK Science, UK Engineering, UK AI & UK Geostrategy. At the very height of UK Academe and UK
Industry. UK Sovereign Integration.**

We work closely with the fire safety sector to provide non-invasive ultrasonic testing solutions

[ Learn More ][128]

Trusted by defence and naval organisations worldwide, our ultrasonic technologies support
mission-critical testing, inspection, and assurance. Designed for demanding operational

In power generation environments, precision and reliability are essential to maintaining performance
and safety. Our ultrasonic testing solutions support the inspection and monitoring of critical
systems across conventional and renewable energy facilities, helping operators optimise efficiency,

long-term asset reliability across the built environment.

You can register on our website using the exact company name that is on your company's W-9 or
corporate return. Start off by verify your company's address, fill in appropriate boxes, then click
submit. Once you are you registered you can access the website features.

What if I forgot my username/password?

If you forget your username or password, click here, enter your email address and we will email you
your account information. If you forget your email address, please contact your sales
representative.

EquipNet has been revolutionizing the way companies manage their surplus assets for over two
decades. Our clients range in size from small businesses to Fortune 500 multi-national corporations.
We manage the entire sales and redeployment process, handling a single piece of equipment, or
managing your global investment and redeployment program, including plant closures.

## Buy Equipment

EquipNet is the largest online venue for pre-owned manufacturing, packaging, laboratory, test,
electronics, and facility support equipment. Shop 1,000+ equipment categories across 3 sales
channels.

[Auctions][86]

## Sell Equipment

Whether it’s a site closure, a facility reorganization, or simply surplus equipment, EquipNet will
manage the sales process ensuring maximum cash value recovered.

## Manage Equipment

EquipNet’s proprietary technology (ARMS™), along with turnkey capabilities deliver a professionally
managed investment recovery and redeployment program.

closing a facility consisting of three different buildings. The entire facility needed full
clearance and contained an array of over 400 pieces of R&D equipment.
[Read More][105]

### The Success of Buying & Selling Equipment with EquipNet

EquipNet is constantly working on asset disposition projects with multiple clients across the globe
to help companies buy, sell, and manage their surplus. This case study outlines how EquipNet was
able to help our long-term client buying and selling. 
[Read More][106]

### Cookie Production Line: Colombia

This client originally sought out an auctioneer company to help sell a cookie production line from a
facility in Colombia. When the company was unsuccessful in its efforts, the auctioneer directly
reached out to EquipNet for expert assistance.

# Optimal protection for laboratories and enclosed environments.

**Since 1968, Erlab has been the world-leading specialist and inventor of standalone, ductless and
zero-emission filtering fume hoods, enabling chemicals to be handled safely in laboratories.** Since
day one, we have been entirely focused on researching, designing, developing and manufacturing
long-lasting protection solutions. Our primary objective is to provide our users with the most
effective solutions to protect them against chemical inhalation hazards in laboratories. Our
worldwide presence, production facilities and strong research and development activity enable us to
offer the most advanced filtration technology to laboratories in the chemical, pharmaceutical,
cosmetics and food industries, as well as to hospitals and educational institutions.

## Laboratory equipment, safety cabinets & laminar flow systems since 1984

For many decades, FASTER has been a leader in the development and manufacture of** laboratory** and
**industrial equipment**. Our focus is on **biological safety cabinets, fume cupboards, ultra-low
temperature freezers** and **isolator technology** and with over **50,000 **safety cabinets sold
**worldwide **, we set the standard for quality and innovation.

Our product range also includes **laminar flow systems**, **laboratory furniture** and **customised
solutions** that meet the highest safety and quality standards. With our technical expertise and
many years of experience, we serve the needs of our customers in areas such as microbiology,
chemistry, pharmacy, biotechnology, diagnostics, veterinary medicine and industry.

## You own the science.
## We build the infrastructure.

You compound critical medicines, develop tomorrow’s cures, and protect against the next pandemic.

[About us][150]

## One partner. Every complexity.

Some projects are complex. Some are time-sensitive. Some need flexible ownership. All of them need a
partner who owns the infrastructure from day one through long-term support. That’s what Germfree is
built for.

#### Germfree: Your Project Execution Experts

Tap into Germfree’s expertise and resources in **every** project delivery discipline.
* Regulatory & compliance experts
* All engineering disciplines and trades under one roof
* Experts in sourcing cleanroom and laboratory ready components and materials
* A commissioning and qualification team with strategies applicable to Mobile and Modular Facilities
* Installation team that delivers a turnkey facility ready for turnover
* Worldwide 24/7 maintenance team that services and monitors all aspects of your facility

[See our services][155]

#### Germfree is Your Business Partner

Germfree provides a consultative approach to developing your facility strategy that is tailored to
the stage of your business. Whether it be own vs lease, lease to own, and even lease buy back, we
explore the pros and cons of owning mobile or modular facilities. Using cash flow analysis,
throughput analysis, maintenance schedules, and facility lifecycle costs, we provide solutions that
adapt to your capital constraints.
* Germfree is the lease-holder
* We provide maintenance for all of our leased facilities
* We offer simplified payments
* Our leases are flexible in duration, either short (6+ months) and long-term leases

[Learn about leasing][156]

#### Complex Challenges Made Simple

You may be using a facility today that wasn’t initially built for your current operations. Germfree
will build a facility specific to your process workflows and equipment requirements with an
efficient operational flow design. We work alongside you to finalize personnel, material, product,
and waste flows to help you forecast and limit complexities in your manufacturing or research
process.
* Discover Germfree’s [WAYFINDER Program][157]
* Ability to integrate equipment to solve your manufacturing challenges
* We bring our 60 years of experience designing and building critical environments for complex
  processes in the biocontainment, biopharma, and healthcare industries

[Discover Germfree Wayfinder™][158]

#### Germfree: Your Trusted Solutions Partner

Our expertise in design, engineering, and manufacturing paired with our comprehensive services,
including project management, supply chain, commissioning and qualification, and maintenance, allows

meeting all of its customers’ needs.

## Certified Fume Hoods for Safer, Smarter Labs

Engineered for maximum containment and efficiency – fully compliant with SEFA, ASHRAE 110, and EN
14175 standards.

## Future-Ready Lab Furniture Designed for Performance

Modular, ergonomic, and durable – made to adapt to your evolving research and education needs.

## End-to-End Turnkey Lab Solutions from a Trusted Partner

From concept to commissioning – complete lab design, manufacturing, installation, and post-sales
support under one roof.

## Setting Global Benchmarks in Lab Solutions

With over 35 years of innovation, LabGuard, India’s premium lab solutions brand, builds
high-performance fume hoods, modular furniture, and turnkey labs trusted by global leaders and
forward-thinking institutions.

### Certified & Compliant

We adhere to globally recognized standards including **SEFA, ASHRAE 110, and EN 14175**, ensuring
that every LabGuard product meets the highest benchmarks in safety, durability, and performance.

### Smart & Energy-Efficient Solutions

Designed with **advanced airflow systems, VAV technology, and smart monitoring** to ensure energy
savings while maximizing user protection and compliance.

### Customizable for Your Needs

From small labs to large-scale institutions, our solutions are built to order, ensuring optimal
utility, safety, and integration with your facility’s workflows.

[Trusted Icon]

### Trusted by Leading Institutions

Our portfolio includes collaborations with top Indian research centers, universities, and
multinational corporations—reinforcing our position as a trusted partner in scientific excellence.

[India-Design-Mark]

### Recognized for Design Excellence

LabGuard has been honored with **4 India Design Mark awards** for excellence in **product
innovation, aesthetics, and usability, demonstrating** our commitment to creating** future-ready lab
environments** that are as elegant as they are effective

# Laboratory Equipment Manufacturer for Research & Testing

][27]

Labtron Equipment is a leading manufacturer of innovative Laboratory Equipment and Analytical
Equipment for all kinds of laboratory applications. Our laboratory equipment are compact,
energy-efficient, and durable, featuring built-in safety for versatile use. We offer a range of
laboratory equipment and analytical instruments including centrifuges, chillers, incubators, mixers,
freeze dryers, shakers, petroleum testing, water testing, airborne particle counters, biochemistry
analyzers, test chambers, automated stainers, furnaces, GC-MS, HPLC, spectrophotometers, and more,
ensuring comprehensive support for all your laboratory needs. We make sure every product meets our
high standards by carefully checking them with strict quality control measures.

We are ISO 9001:2015 Certified company and all our products comply with stringent International
Standards such as Certificate of Compliance (2014/35/EU Low Voltage Directive & 2014/32/EU Measuring
Instruments Directive), Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) System, ISO 13485:2016, ISO 9001:2015, EC
Declaration of Conformity (In Vitro Diagnostic Medical Devices Directive 98/79/EC) and Certificate
of Conformity (European Pressure Equipment Directive 2014/68/EU).

We can also provide IQ, OQ, and PQ Certifications with our products.

certified firm. Check whether you meet the certification criteria, select an employee to supervise

Accelerate your career, develop your knowledge and skills and access new professional opportunities
with NEBB certification. Choose your discipline, check your eligibility and start your journey
today.

Leading engineers and architects trust NEBB specifications to guide projects with peace of mind. We

# High-Performance Buildings

[ Explore Our Certification Programs ][130]

## NEBB is the premier international certifying association for firms and individuals that deliver
## high performance buildings and systems.

NEBB Certified Firms, Professionals, and Technicians uphold the highest standards in building
enclosure, cleanroom performance testing, and fume hood performance testing, as well as sound and
vibration measurement, building systems commissioning and processes, technical retro-commissioning
of existing buildings, and testing, adjusting and balancing.

 

[ Explore NEBB Disciplines ][131]

## Why Work With NEBB?

[nebb-50-year-anniversary][nebb-50-year-anniversary]

### 50+ Years Experience

NEBB has been considered the gold standard in building system certifications since its inception in
1971.

### Unparalleled Quality 

NEBB is the only high-performance Building System organization offering certifications across 8
disciplines.

### Trusted Globally

NEBB has certified over 750 firms and 3,205 individuals across multiple countries and continents.

### Led by Experts 

NEBB disciplines are overseen by leading figures in their field, ensuring exacting standards
throughout the qualification process.

## Our Certification Programs

## Firm Certification

Build your reputation, improve your offering and gain a competitive advantage by becoming a NEBB
certified firm. Check whether you meet the certification criteria, select an employee to supervise
NEBB-related work and get started today. 

[ Get Certified ][132]

## Individual Certification 

Accelerate your career, develop your knowledge and skills and access new professional opportunities
with NEBB certification. Choose your discipline, check your eligibility and start your journey
today.

[ Get Certified ][133]

## Download NEBB Specifications

Leading engineers and architects trust NEBB specifications to guide projects with peace of mind. We
provide best-in-class industry standards across 8 disciplines to ensure every building meets the
most up-to-date requirements – lowering costs and achieving optimal system performance.

About Us

## Established in 1980

We are close to 5 decades now, Newtronic Lifecare Equipment Pvt Ltd has grown to become one of the
leading brands in not only laboratory & pharmaceutical equipment but also it has marked its forte in
various sectors like, agriculture, health, nutraceuticals and many more. With a legacy of innovation
and excellence, Newtronic has consistently delivered high-quality, reliable, and cutting-edge
solutions to meet the evolving needs of the industry. Newtronic trusted by professionals worldwide,
we are dedicated to maintaining the highest standards of safety, precision, and efficiency, ensuring
our clients achieve optimal performance in their critical operations.

[Know More][93]
Our Cutting Edge

## Technology

Ethernet Communication

Offers high-speed data transfer, surpassing serial (RS-485) communication, and adheres to a global
standard for communication protocol, enabling data operations from any PC over the LAN without
requiring a separate PC interface.

2nd Generation I-Series Controllers

With no data loss, the PLC stores up to 1000 readings, allowing data storage for up to 20 days with
readings taken at 30-minute intervals.

Touch Screen Display

The system features both password-based and biometric access control, effectively restricting access
to unauthorized persons.

Complete Range Of Alarms

The system monitors temperature and humidity deviations, door openings, water supply failures,
component failures, and mains failures.

Alarm Transmissions

Alarm transmissions are sent to the software, remote locations such as a security gate, through
detailed SMS notifications, and locally at the equipment with audio-visual indications and on the
display.

Humidity System

The humidity system utilizes non-condensing steam injection for reach-ins and small capacity
walk-ins, and operates on the principles of dew point control for walk-ins.

About Us

## Established in 1980

We are close to 5 decades now, Newtronic Lifecare Equipment Pvt Ltd has grown to become one of the
leading brands in not only laboratory & pharmaceutical equipment but also it has marked its forte in
various sectors like, agriculture, health, nutraceuticals and many more. With a legacy of innovation
and excellence, Newtronic has consistently delivered high-quality, reliable, and cutting-edge
solutions to meet the evolving needs of the industry. Newtronic trusted by professionals worldwide,
we are dedicated to maintaining the highest standards of safety, precision, and efficiency, ensuring
our clients achieve optimal performance in their critical operations.

[Know More][93]
Our Cutting Edge

## Technology

Ethernet Communication

Offers high-speed data transfer, surpassing serial (RS-485) communication, and adheres to a global
standard for communication protocol, enabling data operations from any PC over the LAN without
requiring a separate PC interface.

2nd Generation I-Series Controllers

With no data loss, the PLC stores up to 1000 readings, allowing data storage for up to 20 days with
readings taken at 30-minute intervals.

Touch Screen Display

The system features both password-based and biometric access control, effectively restricting access
to unauthorized persons.

Complete Range Of Alarms

The system monitors temperature and humidity deviations, door openings, water supply failures,
component failures, and mains failures.

Alarm Transmissions

Alarm transmissions are sent to the software, remote locations such as a security gate, through
detailed SMS notifications, and locally at the equipment with audio-visual indications and on the
display.

Humidity System

The humidity system utilizes non-condensing steam injection for reach-ins and small capacity
walk-ins, and operates on the principles of dew point control for walk-ins.

## Internet de las cosas Soluciones en la nube

[

### Soluciones de red de sangre

IoT Gestión inteligente de la seguridad de la sangre proporciona una plataforma sistematizada segura
y unificada para el suministro de sangre de toda la ciudad. 

Leer más
][74] [

### Soluciones de red de laboratorio

Haier Biomédica proporciona soluciones de protección para operadores, muestras y el medio ambiente.
Desde la evaluación del sitio y la planificación del diseño antes de la construcción del laboratorio
hasta el diseño de infraestructura estandarizado, apoyar gabinetes de seguridad biológica, bancos
limpios, refrigeradores sin chispas y otras soluciones de productos durante la construcción del
laboratorio. 

Leer más
][75] [

### Soluciones de red de vacunas

Desde vacunas problemáticas, vacunas expiradas hasta vacunas mal escritas, varios tipos de
incidentes de vacunas han expuesto problemas como la falta de vacunación inteligente y la regulación
de vacunas no científicas y no reguladas, que han afectado gravemente la salud de los niños y se han
convertido en un foco común de la sociedad.

Leer más
][76] [

### Soluciones de red de reactivos

Basado en la aplicación de la tecnología IoT inteligente en productos médicos refrigerados, Haier
Biomédica realiza un seguimiento de la información en tiempo real de cada término en el
almacenamiento y una gestión completa automática e inteligente de reactivos y medicamentos



Leer más
][77] [

### Soluciones de red de muestra

En el área de los biobancos, Haier Biomédica realiza la interacción tripartita en tiempo real de
humanos, máquinas y muestras por la combinación del almacenamiento criogénico y el sistema de
gestión de IoT. Nuestras soluciones no solo pueden monitorear y controlar de manera efectiva la
temperatura de las muestras y el estado operativo de los equipos, sino que también cumplen con los
requisitos de los usuarios para el posicionamiento preciso de las muestras, la verificación y la
disposición rápida, lo que mejora en gran medida la precisión y la eficiencia de la gestión de
muestras biológicas y pone en marcha la revolución de la gestión de muestras.  
Leer más
][78]

## Estudios de casos

U-Red de biobancos
U-Red de vacunas
U-Red de reacitvos
U-Red de sangre
U-Red de laboratorio
[

### Hospitales de enseñanza en Inglaterra

Modelo: Congelador biomédico DW-25L262 El Centro de Investigación Clínica NIHR Sheffield,
-proporciona investigaciones de vanguardia que incluyen investigaciones que pueden salvar vidas en
diabetes, enfermedades respiratorias, óseas y renales. 

Leer más
][79]
[

### University of Sydney in Australia

El proyecto de muestra se ha establecido en la universidad de renombre internacional que muestra un
fuerte efecto de demostración para establecer un excelente ejemplo para la promoción de congelador
ULT de frecuencia inteligente de Haier. Y al mismo tiempo, los clientes de la industria médica
australiana dan tan apreciados de los congeladores ULT de frecuencia inteligente de Haier.

Leer más
][80]

### Soluciones de red de sangre

y unificada para el suministro de sangre de toda la ciudad. 

Leer más
][74] [

### Soluciones de red de laboratorio

Haier Biomédica proporciona soluciones de protección para operadores, muestras y el medio ambiente.
Desde la evaluación del sitio y la planificación del diseño antes de la construcción del laboratorio
hasta el diseño de infraestructura estandarizado, apoyar gabinetes de seguridad biológica, bancos
limpios, refrigeradores sin chispas y otras soluciones de productos durante la construcción del
laboratorio. 

Leer más
][75] [

### Soluciones de red de vacunas

Desde vacunas problemáticas, vacunas expiradas hasta vacunas mal escritas, varios tipos de
incidentes de vacunas han expuesto problemas como la falta de vacunación inteligente y la regulación
de vacunas no científicas y no reguladas, que han afectado gravemente la salud de los niños y se han
convertido en un foco común de la sociedad.

Leer más
][76] [

### Soluciones de red de reactivos

Biomédica realiza un seguimiento de la información en tiempo real de cada término en el
almacenamiento y una gestión completa automática e inteligente de reactivos y medicamentos



Leer más
][77] [

### Soluciones de red de muestra

En el área de los biobancos, Haier Biomédica realiza la interacción tripartita en tiempo real de
humanos, máquinas y muestras por la combinación del almacenamiento criogénico y el sistema de
gestión de IoT. Nuestras soluciones no solo pueden monitorear y controlar de manera efectiva la
temperatura de las muestras y el estado operativo de los equipos, sino que también cumplen con los
requisitos de los usuarios para el posicionamiento preciso de las muestras, la verificación y la
disposición rápida, lo que mejora en gran medida la precisión y la eficiencia de la gestión de
muestras biológicas y pone en marcha la revolución de la gestión de muestras.  
Leer más

clean air, containment and environmental control solutions to support laboratories, healthcare,
pharmaceutical, research and industrial facilities around the world.

[ [breeze-group] Our Portfolio ][8]

### Contained Air Solutions

Contained Air Solutions provides clean air and containment systems that enable safer, more efficient
controlled environments.

From Biological Safety Cabinets and Isolators to Automation and Industrial Containment, our tailored
solutions combine expert design, installation, and lifetime support to meet the exact needs of your
laboratory or facility.

[ [breeze-group] Visit website ][9] [

### BioSpherix

BioSpherix delivers Cytocentric® environments that put cell and tissue health first.

From precision gas controllers to modular incubator subchambers and the Xvivo System®, our solutions
provide reliable, self-sanitizing, and physiologically relevant conditions for optimal cell care.

[ [breeze-group] Visit website ][11] [
[breeze-group] [breeze-group]
Read more ][12]

### Amercare

Amercare delivers isolator and containment solutions that protect your people, products, and
workspace.

From sterile pharmacy doses to radioactive materials, our bespoke systems bring clarity, control,
and confidence to critical environments, supporting precision and long-term, future-ready
performance.

[breeze-group] [breeze-group]
